label: Cross Cluster Versioning (CCV)
type: a bucket property, available since Server 8.0, that both source and target clusters must enable to use XDCR conflict logging. xdcr:optimistic-replication-threshold's own optimistic-replication mode is applicable only when CCV is DISABLED - the two features are mutually exclusive on one bucket.
evidence: To enable conflict logging, both the source and target clusters must run Server version 8.0 or later, and have the bucket property Cross Cluster Versioning (CCV) enabled on their buckets.
XDCR optimistic replication is applicable only when the enableCrossClusterVersioning property is disabled.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a bucket use both XDCR conflict logging and optimistic replication at the same time, or do the two settings exclude each other?
